HOW TO APPLY

We review applications carefully. Please follow these steps exactly — attention to detail matters.

1. Send an email with the subject line: "Claude AI Specialist — [Your Name]"
2. Include a brief (3–5 sentence) summary of your most impressive Claude AI or AI agent project
3. Attach your CV or link to your portfolio / GitHub with relevant AI work
4. Answer this question in your email: "Describe one agentic workflow you have built with Claude and what tools or integrations it used."

Applications without the project summary or the screening question answered will NOT be reviewed.
